agreements_completed_at_matches_status.name: agreements_completed_at_matches_status
agreements_completed_at_matches_status.value: ("agreements"."status" <> 'signed' OR "agreements"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("agreements"."status" <> 'awaiting_signatures' OR "agreements"."completed_at" IS NULL)

agreements_pdf_after_completion.name: agreements_pdf_after_completion
agreements_pdf_after_completion.value: "agreements"."pdf_storage_key" IS NULL OR "agreements"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL

proposal_revisions_split_valid.name: proposal_revisions_split_valid
proposal_revisions_split_valid.value: "proposal_revisions"."creator_split_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "proposal_revisions"."builder_split_pct" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "proposal_revisions"."creator_split_pct" + "proposal_revisions"."builder_split_pct" = 100

tasks_completed_by_only_when_done.name: tasks_completed_by_only_when_done
tasks_completed_by_only_when_done.value: "tasks"."done_at" IS NOT NULL OR "tasks"."completed_by_user_id" IS NULL

threads_kind_matches_parent.name: threads_kind_matches_parent
threads_kind_matches_parent.value: ("threads"."kind" = 'proposal' AND "threads"."proposal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."collab_id" IS NULL) OR ("threads"."kind" = 'collab' AND "threads"."collab_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."proposal_id" IS NULL)

launches_paused_iff_paused_at.name: launches_paused_iff_paused_at
launches_paused_iff_paused_at.value: ("launches"."status" = 'paused') = ("launches"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL AND "launches"."paused_by" IS NOT NULL)

launches_paused_by_only_when_paused.name: launches_paused_by_only_when_paused
launches_paused_by_only_when_paused.value: "launches"."paused_by" IS NULL OR "launches"."paused_at" IS NOT NULL

launches_live_has_went_live_at.name: launches_live_has_went_live_at
launches_live_has_went_live_at.value: "launches"."status" NOT IN ('live', 'paused') OR "launches"."went_live_at" IS NOT NULL

launches_submitted_unless_draft.name: launches_submitted_unless_draft
launches_submitted_unless_draft.value: "launches"."status" NOT IN ('pending_approval', 'admin_review') OR "launches"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL

launches_complete_unless_draft.name: launches_complete_unless_draft
launches_complete_unless_draft.value: "launches"."status" = 'draft' OR ("launches"."price_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "launches"."delivery_type" IS NOT NULL)

orders_ledger_needs_balance_transaction.name: orders_ledger_needs_balance_transaction
orders_ledger_needs_balance_transaction.value: "orders"."ledger_posted_at" IS NULL OR "orders"."stripe_balance_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL

orders_refunded_status.name: orders_refunded_status
orders_refunded_status.value: "orders"."status" = 'disputed' OR ("orders"."status" = 'paid' AND "orders"."amount_refunded_cents" = 0) OR ("orders"."status" = 'partially_refunded' AND "orders"."amount_refunded_cents" > 0 AND "orders"."amount_refunded_cents" < "orders"."amount_gross_cents") OR ("orders"."status" = 'refunded' AND "orders"."amount_refunded_cents" = "orders"."amount_gross_cents")

refund_requests_decided_columns.name: refund_requests_decided_columns
refund_requests_decided_columns.value: ("refund_requests"."status" = 'pending') = ("refund_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("refund_requests"."decided_at" IS NULL) = ("refund_requests"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL)

tracked_links_promotion_needs_code.name: tracked_links_promotion_needs_code
tracked_links_promotion_needs_code.value: "tracked_links"."stripe_promotion_code_id" IS NULL OR "tracked_links"."discount_code" IS NOT NULL

users_deleted_anonymised.name: users_deleted_anonymised
users_deleted_anonymised.value: "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL OR ("users"."email" IS NULL AND "users"."name" IS NULL AND "users"."avatar_url" IS NULL AND "users"."status" = 'suspended' AND NOT ('admin' = ANY("users"."roles")))

audience_snapshots_countries_have_basis.name: audience_snapshots_countries_have_basis
audience_snapshots_countries_have_basis.value: "audience_snapshots"."countries_basis" IS NOT NULL OR "audience_snapshots"."top_countries" IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length("audience_snapshots"."top_countries") = 0

social_connections_manual_has_no_tokens.name: social_connections_manual_has_no_tokens
social_connections_manual_has_no_tokens.value: "social_connections"."source" <> 'manual' OR ("social_connections"."access_token_enc" IS NULL AND "social_connections"."refresh_token_enc" IS NULL)

social_connections_sync_error_has_time.name: social_connections_sync_error_has_time
social_connections_sync_error_has_time.value: "social_connections"."last_sync_error" IS NULL OR "social_connections"."last_sync_error_at" IS NOT NULL

ideas_published_has_time.name: ideas_published_has_time
ideas_published_has_time.value: "ideas"."status" NOT IN ('open', 'in_collab', 'launched') OR "ideas"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

products_published_has_time.name: products_published_has_time
products_published_has_time.value: "products"."status" NOT IN ('seeking', 'in_collab', 'launched') OR "products"."published_at" IS NOT NULL

matches_features_vector.name: matches_features_vector
matches_features_vector.value: jsonb_typeof("matches"."features") = 'object' AND "matches"."features" ?& ARRAY['semantic', 'topic_overlap', 'audience_fit', 'format_fit', 'stage_fit', 'price_fit', 'reliability'] AND ("matches"."features" - ARRAY['semantic', 'topic_overlap', 'audience_fit', 'format_fit', 'stage_fit', 'price_fit', 'reliability']) = '{}'::jsonb AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("matches"."features" -> 'semantic') = 'number' THEN ("matches"."features" ->> 'semantic')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1 ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("matches"."features" -> 'topic_overlap') = 'number' THEN ("matches"."features" ->> 'topic_overlap')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1 ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("matches"."features" -> 'audience_fit') = 'number' THEN ("matches"."features" ->> 'audience_fit')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1 ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("matches"."features" -> 'format_fit') = 'number' THEN ("matches"."features" ->> 'format_fit')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1 ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("matches"."features" -> 'stage_fit') = 'number' THEN ("matches"."features" ->> 'stage_fit')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1 ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("matches"."features" -> 'price_fit') = 'number' THEN ("matches"."features" ->> 'price_fit')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1 ELSE false END AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof("matches"."features" -> 'reliability') = 'number' THEN ("matches"."features" ->> 'reliability')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1 ELSE false END

matching_config_json_objects.name: matching_config_json_objects
matching_config_json_objects.value: jsonb_typeof("matching_config"."weights") = 'object' AND ("matching_config"."model" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("matching_config"."model") = 'object') AND ("matching_config"."metrics" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("matching_config"."metrics") = 'object')

ledger_entries_unpaid_idx.name: ledger_entries_unpaid_idx
ledger_entries_unpaid_idx.where: "ledger_entries"."transfer_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_adjustment_account.name: ledger_entries_adjustment_account
ledger_entries_adjustment_account.value: "ledger_entries"."adjustment_id" IS NULL OR ("ledger_entries"."account" = 'adjustment' AND "ledger_entries"."refund_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."chargeback_id" IS NULL)

ledger_entries_cause_has_order.name: ledger_entries_cause_has_order
ledger_entries_cause_has_order.value: ("ledger_entries"."refund_id" IS NULL AND "ledger_entries"."chargeback_id" IS NULL) OR "ledger_entries"."order_id" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_transfer_needs_user.name: ledger_entries_transfer_needs_user
ledger_entries_transfer_needs_user.value: "ledger_entries"."transfer_id" IS NULL OR "ledger_entries"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_share_has_user.name: ledger_entries_share_has_user
ledger_entries_share_has_user.value: "ledger_entries"."account" NOT IN ('creator_share', 'builder_share') OR "ledger_entries"."user_id" IS NOT NULL

disputes_review_columns.name: disputes_review_columns
disputes_review_columns.value: ("disputes"."status" = 'open') = ("disputes"."in_review_at" IS NULL) AND ("disputes"."in_review_at" IS NULL) = ("disputes"."in_review_by_user_id" IS NULL)

disputes_resolution_columns.name: disputes_resolution_columns
disputes_resolution_columns.value: CASE WHEN "disputes"."status" = 'resolved' THEN "disputes"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "disputes"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "disputes"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "disputes"."resolution_note" IS NOT NULL AND "disputes"."resolution_note" ~ '[^[:space:]]' AND char_length("disputes"."resolution_note") <= 2000 ELSE "disputes"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "disputes"."resolved_by" IS NULL AND "disputes"."outcome" IS NULL AND "disputes"."resolution_note" IS NULL END

impersonation_sessions_end.name: impersonation_sessions_end
impersonation_sessions_end.value: ("impersonation_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("impersonation_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL) AND ("impersonation_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "impersonation_sessions"."ended_at" >= "impersonation_sessions"."started_at") AND ("impersonation_sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL OR "impersonation_sessions"."end_reason" IN ('stopped', 'replaced', 'expired'))
